items.title: Meeting Vikram Chandra of NDTV
items.description: Pppssstttt. One of those strange meeting with interesting people. [Vikram Chandra](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vikram_Chandra_(journalist)) had just left NDTV and was trying to do something of his own. He has seen my work while we were trying to do something for NDTV. It is a long and weird but interesting story that didn’t really worked out. Vikram met us at a Hotel room with my friend and I, had dinner, sketch out some ideas of an interesting product that he was planning.

items.title: Bullet Journal Pocket Notebook
items.description: I like the idea and have picked up some of it in my own system, from the [Bullet Journal Method](https://bulletjournal.com). Bought a pocket notebook to try out. Good paper but just a notebook under their branding. Any notebook can follow the Bullet Journal Method or a remix of your own.

items.title: Meeting Graham Norton in London
items.description:
Was early for a meeting, and so look around for a Book store. Found the BookBar Islington, London. Browse around for over 15-minutes not realizing that Graham Norton was being interviewed behind me.

Pretty much learnt a lot of English Humor and Sarcasm from The Graham Norton Show. Well, meeting him was ‘Surreal but Nice’ and the first thing that came out of my mouth was, “Oh, Dear Lord.”
